status.summary: UFC women's flyweight champion. She was due to challenge Valentina Shevchenko at UFC 332 in Salt Lake City (Oct 3, 2026); after Shevchenko vacated through injury on Sep 5, she beat Wang Cong for the vacant title by unanimous decision (48-47, 48-47, 49-46). She is 9-0 in the UFC and has won 15 straight; pro record 21-5-1 (ESPN, Wikipedia). Her run includes decisions over Rose Namajunas (UFC 324, Jan 24, 2026), Alexa Grasso (UFC 315, May 10, 2025) and Jessica Andrade (Sep 7, 2024). No first defence was booked as of Nov 6, 2026: she said she wants to be an 'active champion' and named no opponent, and has told Shevchenko to 'get in line'. No injury from the Wang fight was reported.

her first title fight was close: Wang Cong landed 98 significant strikes to her 109, won the leg exchanges (34 of 56 leg strikes landed) and lost 48-47 on two cards
only one five-round fight, and no title defence yet
her last six wins all went to decision; her last finish was in May 2023
style.summary: A southpaw kickboxer who fights almost entirely at range (95% of her significant attempts are at distance), throws above-average volume and gets busier as fights go on. She has not been knocked down in nine UFC fights and stops nearly every takedown. Her early UFC finishes came from a spinning back kick and a single punch, but her last six wins went to the cards.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. In fighters.json her decayed significant attempts go 73.9% head, 15.3% body and 10.8% legs (landed 57.7/22.7/19.5; career attempts almost the same at 74.0/15.3/10.7). The women's flyweight averages are 77.3/14.0/8.7, so she goes to the body and legs a little more than most. Accuracy is 36% head, 68% body and 83% legs. No web scouting source could be read in this pass, and ufcstats does not log strike types, so the within-group splits are judgement. Head kick 0.14 is set high for a kickboxer whose best-known finish is a kick. Body kicks lead the body group because her body work is all at distance (95% of attempts). Legs are split evenly because the data cannot tell calf kicks from inside kicks. spinning 0.12 reflects the spinning back kick KO of Bleda. Knees and elbows are near zero because 3% of her attempts come in the clinch and 2% on the ground.

engine_notes.note: Output climbs through 3-round fights: in full rounds she lands 18.7, 23.6 and 28.5 significant strikes per round in rounds 1-3 (7, 7 and 6 rounds). Her one 5-round fight runs 1.00, 0.81, 1.44, 1.50 and 2.06 of round 1, but that pace comes from one fight only.
Volume (decayed): 9.9 significant attempts and 4.5 landed per minute, against division norms of 9.2 and 4.0. She absorbs 2.9 per minute, and opponents land 38.5% on her.

Power: 0.84 knockdowns per 100 significant head strikes landed (decayed) against a women's flyweight rate of 0.25. That comes from three career knockdowns (Bleda, Leonardo and Wang Cong in round 2). Chin: she has absorbed no knockdowns in 9 UFC fights.

Takedown defence is 89% decayed and 90% career (opponents 3 of 31). Opponents still get 129 s of control per 15 min decayed, mostly Viviane Araujo's 6:01 in Feb 2024. Her own wrestling is light: 0.9 takedowns per 15 min decayed.
